reconcile_duplicates.description: Delete zero-bypass rival tag rulesets where a healthy sibling exists

limit.description: Process at most N repositories (0 = all)

steps.name: Mint an App installation token for hyperpolymath
Mint an App installation token for metadatastician
Assert a credential exists
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
if [ -n "${APP_USER:-}" ] || [ -n "${PAT:-}" ]; then
  echo "credential present"; exit 0
fi
cat >&2 <<'MSG'
FATAL: no credential can write rulesets.

Rulesets need administration:write on every target repository.
GITHUB_TOKEN is repo-scoped and cannot do this, so this workflow
refuses to run rather than report a clean sweep over nothing.

Supply EITHER:
  * vars.RULESET_APP_ID + secrets.RULESET_APP_PRIVATE_KEY for a
    DEDICATED GitHub App holding administration:write, installed on
    hyperpolymath AND on metadatastician. NOT OikosBot (the bypass
    actor) and NOT the pin applier's vars.APP_ID App. Preferred:
    an installation token has its own rate limit.
  * secrets.ESTATE_ADMIN_TOKEN — a PAT with repo administration.

Measured 2026-09-15: no ruleset credential exists on this repository.
MSG
exit 3

steps.name: Converge hyperpolymath (user-owned repositories)
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
args=()
[ "$IN_APPLY" = "true" ] && args+=(--apply)
[ "$IN_RECONCILE" = "true" ] && args+=(--reconcile-duplicates)
[ "$IN_LIMIT" != "0" ] && args+=(--limit "$IN_LIMIT")
rc=0
./scripts/apply-tag-ruleset-canon.sh "${args[@]+"${args[@]}"}" \
  | tee canon-user.tsv || rc=$?
echo "rc=$rc" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

steps.name: Converge metadatastician (organisation repositories)
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
args=(--skip-user)
[ "$IN_APPLY" = "true" ] && args+=(--apply)
[ "$IN_RECONCILE" = "true" ] && args+=(--reconcile-duplicates)
rc=0
./scripts/apply-tag-ruleset-canon.sh "${args[@]}" \
  | tee canon-org.tsv || rc=$?
echo "rc=$rc" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

steps.name: Fail while drift remains
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
u="$RC_USER"; o="$RC_ORG"
echo "hyperpolymath rc=${u:-unrun}  metadatastician rc=${o:-unrun}"
for f in canon-user.tsv canon-org.tsv; do
  [ -f "$f" ] || continue
  echo "--- $f"
  awk -F'\t' '{c[$2]++} END {for (k in c) printf "  %5d  %s\n", c[k], k}' "$f"
done
if [ "${u:-0}" = "4" ] || [ "${o:-0}" = "4" ]; then
  echo "::error::A canonical bypass actor's GitHub App is not installed on an owner. ONE body everywhere is the decision, so there is deliberately no admin-only fallback. The owner must install the App; an API token cannot."
  exit 1
fi
[ "${u:-0}" = "0" ] && [ "${o:-0}" = "0" ] || {
  echo "::error::tag ruleset drift remains; see the report artifact"; exit 1; }
echo "estate is on canon"
